name: Neutral on white

guidance.scope: Brand palette and color usage; digital spacing and type sizes are not slide prescriptions.
Native source preview: word-count, 20pt minimum, single-line and one-highlight guidance.

application_rules: These are proposed component contracts derived from guidance, not WM-approved reusable components.
Map semantic roles at object or text-run level. Never replace every occurrence of a source hex value.
Preserve source typography, geometry, crops and alpha/color transforms until an explicit adaptation is approved.
Keep data-series, actor-responsibility, timeline-phase, status and intensity colors separate from presentation roles. Require a legend or explicit semantic binding.
Yellow is reserved for marker-style emphasis behind one to four headline words; no general yellow surfaces or data encoding.
Blue accent is for text and rules, not a general background fill. Magenta accent requires readable contrast; preserve navy foreground on magenta surfaces.
White on magenta is limited to large text (18pt regular or 14pt bold). Do not infer these conditions while effective typography is unresolved.
Use Arial for new Office typography. Preserve observed source fonts in exact reconstruction; web size/spacing tokens are not PowerPoint dimensions.
Headline marks require word-level geometry and layering; source-observed placement does not approve dynamic placement.

Graphics and Layouts slide 164: headline highlights require at least 20pt, one to four words on one line, and at most one highlight graphic per headline. Follow the source sizing principle rather than arbitrary stretching.

application_rules: These are proposed component contracts derived from guidance, not WM-approved reusable components.
Map semantic roles at object or text-run level. Never replace every occurrence of a source hex value.
Preserve source typography, geometry, crops and alpha/color transforms until an explicit adaptation is approved.
Keep data-series, actor-responsibility, timeline-phase, status and intensity colors separate from presentation roles. Require a legend or explicit semantic binding.
Yellow is reserved for marker-style emphasis behind one to four headline words; no general yellow surfaces or data encoding.
Blue accent is for text and rules, not a general background fill. Magenta accent requires readable contrast; preserve navy foreground on magenta surfaces.
White on magenta is limited to large text (18pt regular or 14pt bold). Do not infer these conditions while effective typography is unresolved.
Use Arial for new Office typography. Preserve observed source fonts in exact reconstruction; web size/spacing tokens are not PowerPoint dimensions.
Headline marks require word-level geometry and layering; source-observed placement does not approve dynamic placement.

Graphics and Layouts slide 164: headline highlights require at least 20pt, one to four words on one line, and at most one highlight graphic per headline. Follow the source sizing principle rather than arbitrary stretching.
